pages.text: Opens or closes a door, trapdoor or fence gate.

Any other block raises INVALID_ARGUMENT. Iron doors and iron trapdoors need the permission allowBlockChanges or an administrator as owner, otherwise PERMISSION_DENIED is raised. An empty $(1)dimension$() in the position means the dimension of the trigger block.
$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: where the door is$(li)$(1)open$() BOOLEAN: true to open, false to close
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/SET_OPEN$(br)  PARAMETER position door ;$(br)  PARAMETER open TRUE ;$()
